name: FONBET
note: League title partner; the KHL championship carries the FONBET name (deal khl-fonbet, extended to 2027/28). Club-level partner of Metallurg Magnitogorsk from 2022, extended through 2028 (sports.ru, 2025-09-03); logo on the 2026/27 game kit, front and sleeve. Russian media (RIA Novosti via sportliga.com, 2026-03-20) name Valentin Golovanov as Fonbet's 'managing shareholder' (управляющий акционер); beneficial ownership not publicly documented in sources opened. Its wordmark sits on the chest and both sleeves of Salavat Yulaev's 2026-27 home jersey (club shop product photos).
